PREVIEW : # Build Troubleshooting — Build Tool Fundamentals ## 1. Explanation and Learning Objective This section belongs to **Build Troubleshooting** in Stage 04: Docker Container Engineering. Docker images are immutable templates used to create containers. Images consist of filesystem layers and metadata such as the default command, entrypoint, environment, exposed ports, and working directory. A Dockerfile defines build instructions, while the build engine produces image layers and metadata. Registries store and distribute image manifests and blobs. Reliable image workflows require reproducible builds, controlled base-image versions, vulnerability scanning, image provenance, and deliberate tagging.

PREVIEW : # JUnit 5 Architecture — Testing Strategy and Fundamentals ## Learning Objective JUnit 5 is the modern Java testing platform used to write, discover, and execute automated tests. It is not a single library. JUnit 5 consists of JUnit Platform, JUnit Jupiter, and JUnit Vintage. Understanding these parts helps developers configure test execution correctly in Maven, Gradle, IDEs, and CI pipelines. ## Core Architecture JUnit Platform provides the foundation for launching testing frameworks. JUnit Jupiter provides the programming model and extension model for writing JUnit 5 tests. JUnit Vintage allows older JUnit 3 and JUnit 4 tests to run on the JUnit Platform during migration. ## Practical Exam

PREVIEW : # Trivy Fundamentals — Security Scanning Fundamentals ## 1. Overview and Purpose This section explains "Trivy Fundamentals — Security Scanning Fundamentals" within the navigation topic "Trivy Fundamentals" in the Trivy security scanning workflow.
